snippet.title: linguamarina
snippet.description:
Hey there! I am an entrepreneur and YouTuber. One day I realized I want to move to California, got my company LinguaTrip into a top Silicon Valley incubator 500 startups and got an O1 visa sticker in my passport. 

Here are a quick few links to get in touch:

1. If you want to book a language course abroad, sign up for a free consultation here - http://bit.ly/336tIZU
2. If you want to order an ad on one of my channels, please reach out to sales@marinamogilko.co
3. If you need to check your text in English instantly - https://fluent.express
4. If you want to take part in my YouTube course - marinamogilko.co
5. Download my English Workbook - https://www.english.online/
6. My assistant - marina@marinamogilko.co
